Name: Nyapu's Portraits Darker Skin for Demetrius
Author: Oceannist
Description:
Hi! This is an edit for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url] to better match Demetrius' sprite colors (hair+skin).
Requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120782473]allmyknivesaremadeofrubber[/url].

[b]This is NOT a CP file![/b] They are just images!
I don't know how to make content patcher files, sorry!

[b]How to Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download Nyapu's portraits mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]here[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this file and unzip it.
[*]Replace the Demetrius portrait images in the "assets" folder of Nyapu's mod with the images provided here.
[*]Place Nyapu's mod folder in your Stardew Valley mods directory.
[/list]
Remember to keep a copy of Nyapu's original portrait images in case you want to switch back!

Thanks to Nyapu for making this amazing mod and for the permission to upload this.
Sorry for my English!
